# Every screen, until the APK is the web

One line per surface the site serves, and the state of its native port (#882). `native` means the shell draws it and `check:visual` passes; `todo` means the app opens the document for it; `blocked` means it cannot be worked yet and the line says why. The rule that decides a line is [ADR-0118](docs/adr/0118-a-port-is-switched-on-by-two-measurements.md): the same boxes, the same styles, and a raster inside the tolerance, recorded from both clients at 393 x 852 @ 2.75. A screen that cannot pass stays the document, which is a finished state, not a failure. `docs/mobile/screens.json` is the machine truth for what is switched on; this list is the order it happens in, and `check:plan` fails when the two disagree.

Generated from `docs/mobile/parity-plan.json`. Do not edit this file; change the JSON and run `npm run check:plan -- --write`.
